newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Harnischfeger cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Harnischfeger cut to hold.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Inc analyst J. Blair Brumley said Monday the firm cut its rating on Harnischfeger Industries Inc to hold from buy, based on uncertainty over the mining, papermaking and materials handling equipment maker's $19 a share hostile takeover bid for Giddings & Lewis Inc.

-- In an interview, Brumley noted that Giddings & Lewis, which posted a loss of $12.5 million in 1996, including a $64.1 million charge for its Integrated Automation business, has had problems for several years. That partially accounts for Harnischfeger stock falling 3-1/2 to 41-7/8 Monday, he said.

-- "You hate to see somebody buy a lot of problems, that's number one," Brumley said. He also noted that Giddings & Lewis would represent a new business for Harnischfeger and that Harnischfeger also told analysts the company might have to issue more equity to pay for the deal.
-- Giddings & Lewis shares were up 6-5/8 at 20-1/4 Monday.
